sn44.2:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn44.2:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā anurādho bhagavato avidūre araññakuṭikāyaṃ viharati.
sn44.2:1.3: atha kho sambahulā aññatitthiyā paribbājakā yenāyasmā anurādho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā anurādhena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
sn44.2:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn44.2:1.5: yo so āvuso anurādha, tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto, taṃ tathāgato imesu catūsu ṭhānesu paññāpayamāno paññāpeti:
sn44.2:1.6: “hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā, na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā”ti.
sn44.2:1.7: yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto, taṃ tathāgato aññatra imehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññāpeti:
sn44.2:1.8: “hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā”ti.
sn44.2:1.9: evaṃ vutte aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn44.2:1.10: yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito, thero vā pana bālo avyattoti.
sn44.2:1.11: atha te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā āyasmantaṃ anurādhaṃ navavādena ca bālavādena ca apasādetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
sn44.2:2.1: atha kho āyasmato anurādhassa acirapakkantesu tesu aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu etadahosi:
sn44.2:2.2: sace kho maṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā uttariṃ puccheyyuṃ,
sn44.2:2.3: kathaṃ vyākaramāno nu khvāhaṃ tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuttavādī ceva bhagavato assaṃ, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyaṃ, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākareyyaṃ, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
sn44.2:2.4: atha kho āyasmā anurādho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā anurādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn44.2:2.5: idhāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato avidūre araññakuṭikāyaṃ viharāmi.
sn44.2:2.6: atha kho bhante sambahulā aññatitthiyā paribbājakā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā mama saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
sn44.2:2.7: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho bhante aññatitthiyā paribbājakā maṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn44.2:2.8: yo so āvuso anurādha tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattippatto taṃ tathāgato imesu catūsu ṭhānesu paññāpayamāno paññāpeti:
sn44.2:2.10: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā”ti.
sn44.2:2.11: evaṃ vuttāhaṃ bhante te aññatitthiye paribbājake etadavocuṃ:
sn44.2:2.12: yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattippatto taṃ tathāgato aññatrimehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññāpeti:
sn44.2:2.14: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā”ti.
sn44.2:2.15: evaṃ vutte bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā maṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn44.2:2.16: yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito, thero vā pana bālo avyattoti.
sn44.2:2.17: atha kho maṃ bhante te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā navavādena ca bālavādena ca apasādetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
sn44.2:2.18: tassa mayhaṃ bhante acirapakkantesu tesu aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu etadahosi:
sn44.2:2.19: sace kho maṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā uttariṃ puccheyyuṃ, kathaṃ vyākaramāno nu khvāhaṃ tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuttavādī ceva bhagavato assaṃ, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyaṃ, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākareyyaṃ, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
sn44.2:5.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn44.2:7.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
sn44.2:11.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā sukhaṃ vāti.
sn44.2:13.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
sn44.2:15.1: tasmātiha anurādha, yaṃ kiñcirūpaṃ atītānāgata paccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ: “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti. evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn44.2:15.5: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā, yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ: “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, nameso attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn44.2:15.6: evaṃ passaṃ anurādha, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati. vedanāyapi nibbindati, saññāyapi nibbindati, saṅkhāresupi nibbindati, viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati.
sn44.2:15.7: nibbindaṃ virajjati. virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn44.2:15.8: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
sn44.2:16.17: vedanāya tathāgatoti samanupassasīti? no hetaṃ bhante.
sn44.2:17.2: rūpaṃ …pe… vedanaṃ …pe… saññaṃ …pe… saṅkhāre. …pe… viññāṇaṃ tathāgatoti samanupassasīti?
sn44.2:17.5: ayaṃ so arūpī avedano asaññī asaṅkhāro aviññāṇo tathāgatoti samanupassasīti?
sn44.2:17.7: ettha te anurādha, diṭṭheva dhamme saccato thetato tathāgate anupalabbhiyamāne kallannu te taṃ vyākaraṇāya:
sn44.2:17.8: “yo so āvuso tathāgato uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto. taṃ tathāgato aññatrimehi catūhi ṭhānehi paññāpayamāno paññāpeti:
sn44.2:17.10: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā”ti?
sn44.2:17.13: pubbe cāhaṃ anurādha, etarahi ca dukkhañceva paññāpemi dukkhassa ca nirodhanti.
